entities.description: A detailed, aged parchment map depicting a coastal landmass with intricate mountain ranges, rivers, and a prominent city labeled 'Winterfell' in the center. The map features a scale bar at the bottom and is surrounded by a body of water with a lighter blue hue, suggesting a sea or ocean. The landmass is rendered in earthy tones with fine lines indicating topographical features.

A stylized, hand-drawn map of the British Isles, including Great Britain and Ireland, rendered in muted earth tones with a parchment-like texture. The landmasses are depicted with irregular, organic coastlines and subtle shading to suggest topography, set against a light blue-green sea with faint wave patterns.
A detailed, aged map of the Greek peninsula, featuring a beige landmass with intricate topographical lines and text labels in a classical font, set against a light blue sea with subtle wave patterns.

A vintage-style map of Europe and North Africa, featuring aged parchment with a yellowed, textured surface and visible creases. The landmasses are depicted in a light beige tone with detailed topographical lines, while the oceans are a muted teal blue. A prominent purple, worm-like creature is illustrated crawling across the Alps region of Europe. The map includes a compass rose in the upper left corner and various place names written in an archaic script.

features.creature: purple, segmented, worm-like, located in Alps
